biggest_catch: The headline $550 requires keeping a $500+/month direct deposit running for 24 straight months; the realistically achievable part is the $350 first-deposit bonus paid within 60 days.
catches: You must not have an existing FourLeaf checking account on which you are the primary account holder, and you must not have previously received a new checking account opening related bonus from FourLeaf.
FourLeaf membership is required, which requires opening and maintaining a $5 savings account.

To receive the initial $350.00 bonus: open a Free Checking, Smart Checking, or Student Checking account between February 2, 2026 and December 31, 2026 (subject to approval), and have a Qualifying Direct Deposit of $500 or more post to the checking account within 90 calendar days of account opening.
The $350 bonus is deposited within 60 calendar days following the initial Qualifying Direct Deposit.

To receive an additional $100 (second bonus): continue to have a Qualifying Direct Deposit post for 12 consecutive months following the month of the initial Qualifying Direct Deposit; deposited within 60 calendar days of the applicable qualifying direct deposit.

To receive another additional $100 (third bonus): continue to have a Qualifying Direct Deposit post for 24 consecutive months following the month of the initial Qualifying Direct Deposit; deposited within 60 calendar days.
Official terms do not state tax reporting for this bonus; expect it may be reported as taxable income (not confirmed in the official terms shown).
Offer ends December 31, 2026. One maximum of $550 across all three bonuses.

steps: Become a FourLeaf member and open a new Free Checking, Smart Checking, or Student Checking account between February 2, 2026 and December 31, 2026.
Within 90 calendar days, have a qualifying direct deposit of $500 or more post to the account.
Receive the $350 bonus within 60 days of that first qualifying direct deposit.
Optionally keep a $500+/month qualifying direct deposit posting for 12 consecutive months (+$100) and 24 consecutive months (+$100), each paid within 60 days.
Confirm with the credit union whether bonuses will be reported to the IRS, since official terms do not state it.

Per official terms: Open between 2/2/2026 and 12/31/2026; first $500+ qualifying direct deposit within 90 days; $350 paid within 60 days of it; +$100 bonuses at the 12- and 24-month direct-deposit anniversaries. Earliest realistic: ~14.0 months (12 monthly DD cycles + up to 2 months).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The offer requires consecutive months of direct deposits — payroll cycles are the hard floor and cannot be compressed. Fastest honest path: set up a real payroll direct deposit immediately (Zelle/bank transfers typically don't count) and keep it running uninterrupted; a missed month restarts the clock.
